floor_area_ratio.formula: Recalculate after official baseline and control data are supplied.
assumptions: The estimate is a low-confidence design reference, not a control value.
floor_area_ratio.reason: No official control plan, current building inventory or ownership data were supplied.
floor_area_ratio.estimated_reference: To be calibrated; no single corridor-wide FAR proposed
floor_area_ratio.estimate_basis: Retain existing urban fabric and use adaptive reuse first.

total_floor_area_sqm.formula: Recalculate after official baseline and control data are supplied.
assumptions: The estimate is a low-confidence design reference, not a control value.
total_floor_area_sqm.reason: No complete building floor count, footprint inventory or approved development intensity was supplied.
total_floor_area_sqm.estimated_reference: 30,000-60,000 sqm of first-round adapted ground-floor/shared space
total_floor_area_sqm.estimate_basis: Capacity reference from the proposed S/M/L/XL program and reuse-first strategy.

building_density.formula: Recalculate after official baseline and control data are supplied.
assumptions: The estimate is a low-confidence design reference, not a control value.
building_density.reason: No official parcel and building-footprint baseline was supplied.
building_density.estimated_reference: Maintain existing district pattern; permanent new-build footprint kept to the minimum necessary
building_density.estimate_basis: Design principle rather than a numeric control.

maximum_building_height_m.formula: Recalculate after official baseline and control data are supplied.
assumptions: The estimate is a low-confidence design reference, not a control value.
maximum_building_height_m.reason: No official height-control or heritage view-corridor data were supplied.
maximum_building_height_m.estimated_reference: S/M/L components generally 3.6-6 m; XL relies on existing buildings
maximum_building_height_m.estimate_basis: Prototype family dimensions only, not a statutory height limit.

parking_supply_count.formula: Recalculate after official baseline and control data are supplied.
assumptions: The estimate is a low-confidence design reference, not a control value.
parking_supply_count.reason: No parking inventory, demand survey or road-redline data were supplied.
parking_supply_count.estimated_reference: Use existing shared parking; add only service and accessible bays after survey
parking_supply_count.estimate_basis: Mobility strategy prioritises walking, cycling and transit.

restack_node_count.formula: Recalculate after official baseline and control data are supplied.
assumptions: The estimate is a low-confidence design reference, not a control value.
restack_node_count.reason: No operating baseline or final site survey was supplied.
restack_node_count.estimated_reference: 12-18 S/M nodes, 3-5 L platforms, 3 XL venues
restack_node_count.estimate_basis: Low-confidence initial operating capacity for the three key areas.

slow_mobility_connectivity.formula: Recalculate after official baseline and control data are supplied.
assumptions: The estimate is a low-confidence design reference, not a control value.
slow_mobility_connectivity.reason: No pedestrian network survey, crossing delay or barrier dataset was supplied.
slow_mobility_connectivity.estimated_reference: Prioritise all identified spine-to-core and east-west cross-link breaks
slow_mobility_connectivity.estimate_basis: Qualitative network target pending measured baseline.

annual_participation_count.formula: Recalculate after official baseline and control data are supplied.
assumptions: The estimate is a low-confidence design reference, not a control value.
annual_participation_count.reason: No event programme, operator capacity or attendance baseline was supplied.
annual_participation_count.estimate_basis: Reference estimate based on distributed public nodes and periodic events; not a commitment.

first_round_capex_rmb.formula: Confirm from surveyed quantities and at least three supplier quotations.
assumptions: Concept-stage range excluding land acquisition, major structural reinforcement, large utility expansion and specialist heritage restoration.
first_round_capex_rmb.reason: No bill of quantities, site connection survey or supplier quotation was supplied.
first_round_capex_rmb.estimated_reference: RMB 20-60 million for three parallel validation packages
first_round_capex_rmb.estimate_basis: Reference capacity of one pilot package in each key area using existing buildings and demountable components.

three_year_network_capex_rmb.formula: Confirm from phased bills of quantities, site surveys and procurement quotations.
assumptions: Concept-stage range for 12-18 S/M nodes, 3-5 L platforms and three existing-building XL venues.
three_year_network_capex_rmb.reason: Final sites, quantities, owners, utilities and procurement method are not confirmed.
three_year_network_capex_rmb.estimate_basis: Broad benchmark range for modular equipment, adaptive reuse, professional review and site connection.

mature_annual_opex_rmb.formula: Confirm from staffing, maintenance, insurance, content, utilities and audit contracts.
assumptions: Reference estimate after the initial network reaches stable operation.
mature_annual_opex_rmb.reason: No operator staffing plan, maintenance contract or utility baseline was supplied.
mature_annual_opex_rmb.estimated_reference: RMB 15-40 million/year at network maturity; RMB 3-8 million/year for first-round pilots
mature_annual_opex_rmb.estimate_basis: Concept-stage operating package covering people, maintenance, insurance, content and audit.

operating_cost_recovery_ratio.formula: Direct enterprise-service, venue, event and brand-collaboration revenue / annual operating cost.
assumptions: Public service and heritage-cultural benefits are not forced into direct commercial revenue.
operating_cost_recovery_ratio.reason: No operator contract, tariff, occupancy or revenue baseline was supplied.
operating_cost_recovery_ratio.estimate_basis: Prudent concept-stage recovery range with mixed public-service and earned-income funding.

annual_demand_matches.formula: Count of registered needs that reach a named collaboration or professional referral.
assumptions: Calibrated after a real 90-day operating baseline.
annual_demand_matches.reason: No existing open-service directory or referral baseline was supplied.
annual_demand_matches.estimate_basis: Reference throughput for three district pilots and a shared directory.

annual_lightweight_validations.formula: Count of registered lightweight validations or product improvements with documented feedback.
assumptions: Excludes statutory certification, manufacturing-line testing and specialist laboratory experiments.
annual_lightweight_validations.reason: No existing programme or operator baseline was supplied.
annual_lightweight_validations.estimated_reference: 10-30 validations or product improvements/year after stabilisation
annual_lightweight_validations.estimate_basis: Reference throughput for L platforms and periodic public or market trials.

annual_participating_firms_merchants.formula: Distinct firms or merchants recorded as challenge owners, collaborators or trial partners.
assumptions: Calibrated after a real 90-day operating baseline.
annual_participating_firms_merchants.reason: No confirmed partner roster or operating baseline was supplied.
annual_participating_firms_merchants.estimated_reference: 15-40 participating firms or merchants/year after stabilisation
annual_participating_firms_merchants.estimate_basis: Reference participation range for the three key-area pilots.

accountable_plugin_coverage_target.formula: AI plug-ins with named spatial, operational and technical owners / all open AI plug-ins
assumptions: Design gate for opening, not a measured current-condition value.

human_takeover_and_exit_coverage_target.formula: AI plug-ins with notice, version, human takeover, shutdown and restoration records / all open AI plug-ins
assumptions: Design gate for opening, not a measured current-condition value.

basic_service_non_ai_fallback_target.formula: Basic public services retaining a human or non-AI route / all basic public services offered by RE:STACK
assumptions: Design gate for opening, not a measured current-condition value.

unresolved_high_risk_expansion_target.formula: Expansion actions allowed while a high-risk safety, privacy or rights issue remains unresolved
assumptions: Mandatory stop rule for staged implementation.

implementation_stage_gate_count.formula: G1 brief/site confirmation + G2 design/lawful procurement + G3 installation/90-day validation + G4 stable operation/expansion
assumptions: Design-stage delivery gates, not evidence of completed implementation.

parallel_pilot_package_count.formula: One independently reviewable first-round package in each key area
assumptions: All three remain HOLD until real sites, operators and professional checks are confirmed.

ai_plugin_passport_required_field_count.formula: Purpose + user + minimum data + version + physical interface + accountable human + non-AI equivalent + trial boundary + stop/restoration trigger + retention/public status
assumptions: Opening gate for every AI-enabled plug-in.

ai_operating_state_count.formula: Offline/manual + sandbox + limited trial + open + paused/retired
assumptions: Transition to a higher-exposure state requires human review.

implementation_handover_record_count.formula: Site passport + permission + professional review + data/privacy + BOQ/quotes + operating/emergency + plug-in/version + removal/restoration
assumptions: Required before real procurement, opening and later restoration.
